Antigravity agents now honour a role's `output_style` and `append_system_prompt`, symmetric to the codex agent type.

`AntigravityAgentConfig` gained the two harness-neutral role fields (`output_style`, `append_system_prompt`), so a create like `--type antigravity -t chat` now resolves the role's output style onto the agent instead of being rejected. At provision time the plugin joins the appended-prompt blocks and the output-style body (read verbatim from `.agents/output-styles`, blocks first, style last) and writes them to the agent's per-agent global rule file `$HOME/.gemini/GEMINI.md`, which agy discovers automatically. agy exposes no config-level system-prompt channel like codex's `developer_instructions`, so this rule file is a peer of the repo's own `AGENTS.md` -- an accepted tradeoff. A rule file over agy's documented 12,000-char limit only logs a non-fatal warning (agy 1.1.10 reads larger files in full).
